headline_rule: The headline confidence signal is the DISAGREEMENT between E1 and E2. The blend is published underneath, labelled as a blend.

hca.rule: PINNED: hca_margin = Phi^-1(measured home-win rate) * sd(margin). Not fitted.
hca.note: The naive fitted HCA (mean home margin) also absorbs any sample imbalance in team strength between home and away schedules. The pinned version uses only the home-win rate, so a schedule artefact cannot inflate it. Both are printed; the model uses the pinned one.

ridge_selection.selected_by: log-loss on the most recent 20% of past games

out_of_sample.note: Walk-forward: each forecast uses only games before it. Pinned HCA is recomputed on the training slice, so the OOS numbers include the cost of that rule.

minutes_gap.why: A redistribution needs both a captured game log and an announced absence for the same club. The logs cover the 11/14 slate and the archived report covers 11/15, so the overlap is what it is; the sensitivity table is illustrative and labelled.

market_prior.rule: blend the model line with the closing line, weight w chosen by measured out-of-sample log-loss
market_prior.blocker: No licensed closing line exists in this repository and the official NBA schedule page does not print prices in the fetched text. w is therefore left BLANK rather than set to a guessed value.
market_prior.what_is_ready: the blend and the log-loss scoring are implemented and run on the model's own OOS sample
